name: devfoundry
description: devFoundry: Claude Code plugins for MuleSoft and API engineering, with integration patterns and project profiles.

plugins.name: integration-patterns
plugins.description: Decides whether an integration flow needs an Enterprise Integration Pattern (Hohpe and Woolf catalog, starting with the Idempotent Receiver) and applies it only when its problem is present, with verified Mule 4 realizations.

plugins.name: resilience-patterns
plugins.description: Decides whether code that calls another system needs a resilience pattern (starting with the Circuit Breaker) against a slow or failing dependency, with verified Mule 4 realizations.

plugins.name: engineering-profile
plugins.description: Applies the project's engineering/profile.yaml (naming, precedence over legacy code) and makes each Mule 4 flow's integration decisions explicit before writing code.

plugins.name: api-contracts
plugins.description: Makes every REST endpoint start from a spec that describes it, writing or extending the spec in the project when the published one lacks it, with rules for OpenAPI 3 and RAML contracts.

plugins.name: mule-engineering
plugins.description: Mule 4 engineering rules with verified examples: the APIkit router and the spec it loads, and MUnit tests that call each endpoint through the HTTP listener.
